main_text.p: missa. Sed vix elapso decennio, parta à Conone victoria navali ad Cnidum, imperioque maris Atheniensibus resti-tuto, rediit ipsa quoque ad societatem Atheniensium: ac rursum à quadrien-nio cum Rhodiis & vicinis aliis Lace-dæmoniorum partibus se reddidit, for-tunam eorum, qui plus poterant, se-quens. Iterum vero cum in potesta-tem Tigranis Persæ regii præfecti forte venisset, isque præsidium ei imposui-set, à Timotheo Cononis filio duce Attico cum classe iltuc delato obsessa, & dejecto præsidio libertati reddita fuit. Nec quicquam præterea in rebus Samiorum apud historiographos veteres memorabile: videturque post id tempus fortuna urbis hujus sensim decrevisse, & mediocris omnino ad sæculum primorum Cæsarum Romanorum pervenisse. Siquidem & libertas à Cæsare Augusto donata fuit, & cum civibus abundaret, pascendi pecoris ergo non parvam eorum multitudinem Strabonis ævo in Icariam tum indigenis infrequentem emisit, ut idem Strabo nos docet.

page.notes: The first word "missa." is a fragment: the page opens mid-word and the start is cut off at the edge. "iltuc" is doubtful (likely "illuc"), "[?]" not added in text since it is printed this way. "fortè" is printed as "forte" with no accent visible. At the foot, "1 4" and "X.D" appear faint and may be pencil or stamp marks rather than printed signature or catchword; not transcribed as printed text. Red marks along the right edge are not printed text and are omitted.
